notes.title: Go Home is dead ?
notes.notes:
Nope ;)

Since we readed much reviews and had some discussions with some of our players we decided to make a complete remake of the game what means:

- New design
- More levels
- Story
- More traps
- Not just mazes, real levels
- Continous higher difficulty
- Not "ripped off" from a YouTuber (We were in contat with him so chill :D )
- InGame-Level Editor (You can create your own levels and upload them to the workshop)
-- We are creating every level with the InGame-Level Editor so you can see whats possible with it, while playing
- More achievements
- Maybe cards / badges
- And much more.... <3

We added an image of our new Title Screen to show off the new style, please notice this isnt the final version of the title screen we just tryed out the ingame editor and some other stuff

Sincerely,
~ Synter Games
~ Global Hive (Soon)

notes.title: New Design, New Levels, New Traps, New New New...
notes.notes:
Since we had much hate about the game and the tutorial stuff...

Again: It was made by our student... but yeah

We are going to recreate it from scratch, the system behind it "Getting home withouth getting killed" still remains the same BUT we are going to change the models, colors, traps, levels (counting difficulty and not just more random mazes) and so on...

The release date for this big remake of the game will be announced soon.

We are thinking also about adding it as seperate launchable option to hold the old style for the players which like it, how it is (Just the style, the levels and traps will get changed)

What do you do think about that ?

Sincerely,
~ Synter Games

notes.title: Update 19092015-1945
notes.notes:
We finnally added a full controller support, including a new keybinding system which will be found under the Options.

We also changed the look of the timer, since the timer gets the most hate at the mails which we receive. It has now his own background and a flashy effect if the time runs out.

We also finished the co-op mode and are testing now with our beta testers, after finishing these tests, it will get released to the public.

Sincerely,
~ Synter Games
